name: Cerno 4B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes:
ADDED 2026-11-27 from the trending sweep. A decision model (task=decision), not a text generator: state + typed questions in, a calibrated probability per option out in ONE forward pass, no output tokens. Full fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (the card's base_model tag is the -Base checkpoint; the board records Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B), served as FP8 W8A8 with lm_head in bf16 and a shipped temperature of 1.534. Licence apache-2.0; card revision v1.1 dated 2026-10-19, repo created 2026-10-16.

PARAMS: params_b 4.206 = safetensors.total from the tool (4,205,751,296 per the board's meta.served_params); the card prints '4B'. The record is DENSE - active_params_b is the same 4.206, NOT the 4.66 the tool inherited from the text base record. KV: 32,768 B/token = 8 full-attention layers x 4 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes (bf16); the other 24 layers are Gated DeltaNet linear attention with a fixed recurrent state, so they add nothing per token. 8 x 4 x 256 x 2 x 2 = 32,768.

EVIDENCE, and why it is NOT self-reported: every number here was read from the board's own machine-readable dump (data/index.json, generated 2026-11-21T14:35:36Z, jev-1.14.0, 110,201 requests, 345 entrants), not from the model card. The card claims 57.60 on the Decision Index 0.3 PUBLIC suite; the board's 0.4.1 rescore of the submitted run is 65.05 public / 53.88 full (balanced_skill), and the board notes the kit rescore AGREED with the claim - different suite versions, so both are true and they are not comparable to each other. vendor_claim is false on every row for that reason.

WHAT IT LOSES: it is NOT first at <=5B on the full score, contrary to the card's 'first at <=5B' line (that claim is about the public index on the 0.3 suite). On the 2026-11-21 0.4.1 board Cerno 4B is 9th of 166 entrants with declared params <=5B by balanced_skill (53.88), behind adjudex-4b-v7 57.25, starlord-4b-preview 56.94, singvl-s1-4b 56.75, knowline-4b-gen5.5 55.99, pplx-decider-flash-v1.3 55.14, startlux-decision-v1.1-4b-instant 54.80, pplx-decider-flash-v1.2 54.29 and chinese-decision-pointer-4b 53.96. Its strengths are the tools axis (87.91, near the top of the whole board) and retrieval (70.54); its weak axis is knowledge (46.65). Calibration ECE 0.0741 at accuracy 0.7593, Brier 0.3409 - worse calibrated than its 27B sibling (0.0629) and than h2o-lightning-31b (0.0405). Median 55.3 ms / p95 471.7 ms per request on 1x RTX PRO 6000, single request - the fastest p95 in this size class on the board, which is the practical reason to run it.

NOT ESTABLISHED: latency on consumer hardware (the board only measures on a PRO 6000); whether the FP8 W8A8 checkpoint runs on a 16 GB card without the lm_head in bf16 spilling; and the private 80% of the board's Full score is pending for this family, so 53.88 is the public-half-balanced figure the board publishes, not a private-test number.
